disease_name: Gastroesophageal reflux disease, Peptic ulcer disease
indication: Acid reflux, Heartburn, Upper abdominal pain, Belching, Weight loss, Vomiting, Poor appetite, Bleeding, Perforation, Blockage of the stomach
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || at fixed time
mechanism_of_action: prevents the final step in gastric acid formation by covalently binding to sulfhydryl groups of cysteines found on the ATPase enzyme at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cell, leading to inhibition of both basal & stimulated gastric acid secretion
side_effects: nausea, headache, diarrhea, abdominal pain, dizziness, constipation, rash, liver injury, bone fractures, hypomagnesemia
